items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Dalkyali never told me that people tell me that.

ctx.x: I'll give you another shot of this tea. Oh, that tea is cold.

That's alright. Oh, whatever. Tea is cold. You can just rinse it out if you like. Go in the bathroom and just rinse it out. No, that's alright. Because that's what I do. Pour it in one of those water glasses. Pour it right in there. There's another one. There's another part of tea there. Try that one. Yeah, that you would have water. Nice. Now this ain't good for me, you know. Not too much water. Tea? You will like this one that ain't good for you. I love tea myself. But Dalkyali never told me that people tell me…
The only thing the doctor told me to lay off a Coca-Cola and I'm crazy about that.
